title: Shaping Earth & Fire: Wild Clay & Pit Fire Pottery Retreat
source_quote: Shaping Earth & Fire: Wild Clay & Pit Fire Pottery Retreat Sun, Oct 25, 2026 6:00 PM Sat, Oct 31, 2026 12:00 PM
summary: A five-day immersive retreat including wild clay processing, handbuilding, and pit firing. No prior experience needed. Currently sold out; waitlist available.
evidence_sentence: The retreat includes an all-day pit firing ceremony on Friday with pottery sealing, teaching low-fire earthenware and ancient firing methods.
evidence_quote: Friday: All day pit firing ceremony and evening pottery sealing
how_to_join: Contact whitesnakearts@gmail.com for waitlist; registration opens March 2027 for next year's retreat
cost_text: $750 for retreat (materials and dinners included); $150 deposit with monthly payment options
commitment: Sun afternoon through Sat morning, Oct 25-31
